projects.title: Pygame-Mario
projects.description:
Project-3-Mario: A Pygame Adventure

Welcome to our exciting game project - Project-3-Mario! This engaging Mario game, developed using the Pygame library in Python, promises hours of entertainment. Immerse yourself in the world of Mario as you navigate through various maps, dodge obstacles, and embark on a thrilling adventure.

Prerequisites:
Before diving into the action, ensure you have Python and Pygame installed on your system. You can install Pygame using the following command:

bash
Copy code
pip install pygame
How to Play:

Run the Mario.py script to launch the game.
Utilize the arrow keys for movement:
Left arrow: Move left
Right arrow: Move right
Space Bar: Jump
Navigate through each level, skillfully avoiding hazards such as lava, spikes, and menacing monsters. Be cautious, as contact with any of these obstacles will result in the end of the game, prompting a restart option.

Discover portal doors within the game to seamlessly progress to the next exciting map. The adventure continues, and challenges intensify as you explore each level.

Menu Page:
On the menu page, take control of your gaming experience:

Start the game with the designated button.
Halt the game at any time using the stop button.
Get ready to embark on a nostalgic journey with Project-3-Mario. Download, play, and let the retro-inspired fun begin!

Link to github repo => https://github.com/royelaawar/Project-3-Mario
